title: Target’s October 2026 New Store Openings
summary: Get details on our newest Target stores opening across the nation, from store hours to fast facts about each location.
body_markdown:
We’re celebrating the opening of eight new stores this fall in Mississippi, New York, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas and Virginia — the last of[more than 30 planned](https://corporate.target.com/press/release/2026/03/target-ramps-up-store-investments-to-fuel-new-chapter-of-growth) for 2026. Each is designed to deliver Target’s elevated guest experience and differentiated style, design and value while strengthening local communities through giving, volunteering and providing good-paying jobs.


Fueling this[chapter of growth](https://corporate.target.com/news-features/article/2026/03/target-growth-strategy-2026) : our $5 billion capital investment plan for 2026, which has supported not only our new stores but also more than 130 remodels, alongside an investment of hundreds of millions of dollars in additional store payroll and training to improve guest service.


These eight stores are the latest examples of the more than 300 we are on track to build by 2035. Seven top our 125,000-square-foot chain average as we expand our assortment and lean into merchandising authority. And we’ve got so much more to offer, with on-trend newness and everyday essentials that provide high quality at an incredible value, whether guests are shopping our aisles or using our same-day services like Drive Up, Order Pickup or same-day delivery with Target Circle 360.


Every new store brings Target's on-trend, affordable assortment closer to more guests, and improves our ability to deliver what you need, when and where you need it. That's because our stores serve as shopping destinations and help us fill online orders. Fun fact: Our stores fulfill 95% of our digital orders, including same-day delivery service with Target Circle 360, which currently reaches 80% of the U.S. population.


Then there’s the people part:[Each addition](https://corporate.target.com/news-features/article/2026/04/new-stores-fuquay-varina-north-carolina) to our 2,000-plus store network provides rewarding jobs whether team members stay with us for a season or a long-term career. We have long invested in our teams, with a starting wage range of $15 to $24 per hour (depending on the role and location), competitive benefits and tuition-free education assistance. (Want to join our team? Check out our[stores job opportunities](https://corporate.target.com/careers/career-areas/stores) .)


We’re also extending Target’s culture of care into the communities we serve to support local needs. This includes investing more than 193,000 hours of community service and more than $64.6 million in product and cash donations last year in Mississippi, New York, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas and Virginia.


“Our continued commitment to opening new stores is really about showing up for our guests and our communities — and it starts with our incredible store team members,” said Chief Stores Officer **Adrienne Costanzo** , who started her Target career 20 years ago at T-108 in Evansville, Indiana. “These new stores give our teams the tools and environments to bring our merchandising strengths to life, create easier and more inspiring shopping experiences, and use technology to move smarter and faster every day. It’s how we keep growing thoughtfully, stay connected to our communities and make Target an even better place to work and shop.”


Add our wide assortment of national and owned brands, and we’re on track to help all families discover the joy of everyday life.
